jobs.title: Staff Backend Software Engineer - Remote (Poland)
jobs.description:
WELCOME TO OLX

We're building marketplace sustainable ecosystems
that millions of people depend on every month – to buy and sell cars, find homes, land jobs, and trade secondhand goods. It's commerce that matters: safe
, smart
, and environmentally responsible
.

We do this with courage
to innovate, commitment
to outcomes, collaboration
across 50+ nationalities and 7 markets, and a customer-led
approach that puts real people first. Add a desire to win
– and you get a culture that's ambitious, fast-moving, and built on trust.

Our brands – including AutoTrader, OLX, Otomoto Property24, and more – are loved by millions. And we're backed by Prosus, one of the world's largest tech investors.

Join OLX And See How Far You Can Go.

Join Our Team as an AI-native Staff Backend Engineer!

Join one of our cross-functional teams in Motors, Real Estate, OLX Classifieds, or Platforms, working remotely from Poland.

Are you someone who is craving scalable problems and dealing with optimizations?

You'll work with a creative, critical, and well-organized team from the comfort of your house, but as close as we have ever been!

You will play a key role in enabling our organisation to scale efficiently.

Who We Are Looking For

You can use agentic workflows (Claude Code, Cursor Agent, or equivalent) as your default, not as a novelty.
You practice context engineering, not just prompt engineering; you design the full information architecture an AI agent needs to succeed: repo structure, CLAUDE.md / AGENTS.md configs, relevant code context, memory, and tool access.
You understand model routing trade-offs (e.g., when to use Haiku vs. Sonnet vs. Opus) and multi-agent orchestration.
Strong ownership instinct: AI output is a first draft, not a deliverable; you validate, refactor, and take full accountability.
You have strong Coding and Computer Science Fundamentals. Roughly ⅔ of your time will be hands-on technical work: designing solutions, steering and reviewing AI-generated code, developing new ideas, and reviewing others' contributions. The rest goes to cross-team influence, mentoring, and strategic alignment.
Strong background experience in Golang, Java/Kotlin (preferred technologies), and able to work with PHP. Flexible and capable of adjusting to changing project requirements, roles, and backend technologies as needed.
Scalable Systems Expertise. Experience with large-scale web applications, an economic-thinking mindset, and being able to design well-bounded future-proof domain systems, aligned with the business objectives.
Deep expertise in scalable distributed systems, CI/CD, RESTful and GraphQL APIs, AWS, and relational + NoSQL databases.
Big-picture thinker: aligns technical decisions with business strategy, influences without authority.
Clear communicator in English across engineering, product, and leadership audiences.
Self-starter who identifies what needs doing and takes initiative without waiting to be asked.
Skilled Technical Leader and Mentor: Guide and support engineers by setting a strong example. As a Staff Engineer, you are a role model, leading by example and through your expertise.

What You Will Be Doing

Architect context pipelines for AI agents: curate what enters the context window (repo boundaries, domain knowledge, test outputs, CI feedback) so agents produce reliable, mergeable code, not just plausible code.
Prepare task specifications that are agent-actionable (clear acceptance criteria, referenced modules, explicit constraints)
Design and maintain agent-ready systems: well-bounded repos, comprehensive test suites as guardrails, CI/CD pipelines with structured output agents can parse and act on.
Serve as an AI Champion: join and strengthen our growing AI Champion community, contribute to workshops, curate effective agentic workflows, and mentor engineers on AI-assisted practices. Contribute to org-level AI tooling evaluations and OLX AI practices repositories.
Drive active migration from a legacy monolith to microservices, owning decisions on bounded domain decomposition. Working on making agentic workflows effective across a codebase whose boundaries are actively being redefined.
Set the bar for GraphQL API design, RESTful contracts, database schema, and CI/CD quality across the tribe.
Work with product and engineering leadership to identify high-value problems, propose initiatives, and drive impactful technical direction without direct authority
Guide senior engineers in managing and reducing technical debt with AI as an accelerator, not a shortcut.

Our Hiring Process

Recruiter Screen
Management Capabilities
System Design
Live Coding

Our Benefits

Monthly salary and an annual bonus (20%)
Training and conference budget, and free access to Udemy courses
A benefits package with 500 points on the Mybenefit platform per month, private medical care provided by Luxmed, Ask Henry services, and much more
IP rights’ costs - 80%
100% remote work (as well as the possibility of working from our offices in Poznan and Warsaw)

If you think this is the role for you, send your application in English and let’s talk!

If you'd like to learn more about us take a look around our careers page and the OLX Group website. Follow us on Linkedin and check out our OLX Group Engineering Blog and Twitter Tech .

Diversity, Equity and Inclusion at OLX

OLX values diversity and welcomes applicants of all races, ethnicities, disabilities, ages, genders, sexual orientations, religions, backgrounds, and experiences to apply. If this role excites you, we encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet all the requirements - you may be just the right fit for this or other opportunities with us!

OLX will process your personal data to assess your fit for the applied position. You may optionally consent to store your data for up to 12 months after the application process for consideration in future OLX roles. For more details on how your application data will be processed please check our Privacy Statement .

jobs.title: Principal Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100672

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, and consulting teams, you will design the knowledge architecture that connects workflows, data, decisions, and insights across the AEC, MFG, and M&E domains. You will establish the semantic models, knowledge graph capabilities, and platform architecture required to support organizational change management, workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications.

This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Sr. Manager, Architecture.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the architectural vision for Workflow Advisory and related knowledge-driven platform capabilities
Design semantic architectures, knowledge models, and knowledge graph capabilities that connect workflows, data, decisions, and insights
Define architecture patterns that enable workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications
Establish standards for knowledge representation, lifecycle management, governance, and reuse across platforms
Translate business workflows into reusable domain models, services, and architectural patterns
Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native architectures that support enterprise and customer-facing solutions
Ensure platform services, APIs, and knowledge assets are discoverable, composable, and consumable by AI-enabled applications
Apply AI and LLM technologies to improve knowledge discovery, workflow execution, and advisory experiences
Collaborate with architects and engineering responsible for ensuring architecture meets enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and SOC2 requirements
Collaborate with product, engineering, and consulting teams to align architecture investments with business outcomes and technology strategy
Drive adoption of architectural standards and reusable platform capabilities across teams
Mentor engineers and architects while communicating architectural direction to senior leadership and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience designing and delivering complex software platforms
Experience as a Software Architect, Product Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience designing AI-enabled, knowledge-driven, or workflow-centric software systems
Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, ontologies, taxonomies, graph databases, or retrieval systems
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agent patterns
Experience leading technical spikes, rapid prototyping efforts, or proof-of-concept development
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices
Experience designing secure, privacy-conscious, and trustworthy software platforms that operate within enterprise governance requirements
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences
Willingness and ability to travel internationally up to 15% of the time is required

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Poland based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 238,000 PLN and 348,700 PLN. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Sales Careers

Working in sales at Autodesk allows you to build meaningful relationships with customers while growing your career. Join us and help make a better, more sustainable world. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/careers/sales

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Job Title: Mid Full Stack Developer

Location: Remote (European Time Zone)-once per month in the office in Cracow

Contract Type: B2B

About Us:

ETFBOOK is a Swiss SaaS company providing data, analytics, and custom solutions in the Exchange Traded Funds (ETFs) space. Founded in 2020, we aim to make global ETF data accessible, actionable, and valuable for institutional participants, including ETF issuers, index providers, fund service providers, market makers, exchanges, and buy-side institutions.
We develop a platform which offers comprehensive insights through a user-friendly web application and robust APIs, covering areas such as product analysis, fund flow tracking, performance comparisons, and liquidity assessments.

About the role:

We are seeking a Full-Stack Software Developer with interest in Frontend development to join our fully remote team spread across Europe.
You’ll join a highly skilled technology team. This team develops and maintains a cutting-edge data analytics platform using most advanced technologies to support all core business functions. You’ll be a part of a collaborative team focused on the application development. This role offers the chance to make a visible impact in a dynamic, fast-evolving field.

Requirements:

4+ years of experience in Web Application Development, the latest: C#, .Net and Angular
Strong communication skills in English.
A commitment to delivering value to the customer.
An emphasis on automation and code quality (we employ automated testing and deployment).
A can-do attitude, willing to roll up your sleeves, but also capable of thoughtful problem-solving before diving in.
Basic knowledge of Azure
Good communication skills.
Eager to learn.
Able to work under supervision.
Shows basic autonomy in assigned tasks.
English - min B2.

Responsibilities:

Development and maintenance of the frontend part of our application, the latest Angular.
Development of backend services the latest .NET - various APIs and Data Processing.
Participation in Solution Design and Requirements Analysis and Requirements Analysis.

What we offer:

100% remote work from anywhere within the European time zone.
Competitive B2B contract.
Exciting growth opportunities in a fast-paced startup.
Impactful work: help revolutionise ETF data market, currently fastest growing area of finance.
Have a real impact of developing products: your work will directly influence live projects, delivering measurable results in real-world applications.
Culture of innovation: collaborate with forward-thinking professionals in technology and finance where experimentation and creativity are encouraged.
Team- buildings events at least twice a year, hosted in various European locations.

jobs.title: Mobile Solution Architect
jobs.description:
Nasz klient to doświadczona firma doradztwa technologicznego, działająca od 2010 roku i realizująca ponad 500 projektów. Specjalizuje się w strategii cyfrowej, projektowaniu UX/UI oraz tworzeniu aplikacji mobilnych, platform webowych i agentów opartych na sztucznej inteligencji. Firma pomaga klientom budować spójne ekosystemy cyfrowe, łącząc kreatywne podejście z solidnym inżynierskim wykonaniem. Oferuje elastyczne modele współpracy — zespoły projektowe, dedykowane oraz dostęp do specjalistów cyfrowych na żądanie — co pozwala dostosować tempo i strukturę pracy do potrzeb klienta. W zespole panuje kultura współpracy, nastawiona na jakość doświadczeń użytkownika i realne wsparcie biznesowe. Obecnie firma poszukuje ekspertów technologicznych: projektantów UX/UI, inżynierów aplikacji mobilnych, web developerów oraz specjalistów AI, którzy chcą współtworzyć zaawansowane produkty cyfrowe na nowoczesnych platformach. To atrakcyjne środowisko dla osób ceniących innowację, pracę zespołową i wpływ na kształtowanie rozwiązań cyfrowych dla klientów z różnych branż.

Mobile Solution Architect

miejsce pracy: Gdańsk

Do zadań osoby na tym stanowisku należeć będzie:

Analiza potrzeb biznesowych oraz wymagań funkcjonalnych i niefunkcjonalnych.
Projektowanie docelowej architektury rozwiązań, sposobu integracji, przepływu danych i komunikacji z systemami zewnętrznymi.
Projektowanie skalowalnych integracji, API oraz rozwiązań działających na wielu platformach.
Podejmowanie i uzasadnianie decyzji dotyczących technologii, frameworków, bibliotek i narzędzi.
Ocena wpływu decyzji architektonicznych na wydajność, bezpieczeństwo, utrzymanie, skalowalność i koszt realizacji.
Przygotowywanie dokumentacji architektonicznej, diagramów, standardów technicznych i rekomendacji dla zespołów.
Prowadzenie rozmów discovery z klientami i identyfikowanie rzeczywistych potrzeb, ograniczeń oraz ryzyk.
Prezentowanie proponowanej architektury, rozwiązań technologicznych i estymacji.
Wsparcie przygotowania ofert, estymacji, odpowiedzi na zapytania ofertowe i RFP.
Techniczne prowadzenie zespołów developerskich w całym cyklu życia projektu.
Organizowanie technicznej części Sprintu 0, w tym przygotowanie środowisk, repozytoriów, CI/CD, standardów kodowania, testowania i bezpieczeństwa.
Definiowanie oraz egzekwowanie standardów clean code, dobrych praktyk architektonicznych i zasad jakości.
Prowadzenie przeglądów architektury oraz wspieranie zespołu podczas code review.
Mentoring mniej doświadczonych członków zespołu oraz wspieranie ich w rozwiązywaniu trudnych problemów technicznych.
Identyfikowanie ryzyk technicznych i komunikowanie ich osobom odpowiedzialnym za projekt.
Współpraca z zespołami UX/UI, QA, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps i Delivery.
Wspieranie odpowiedzialnego wykorzystania narzędzi AI w procesie developmentu, testowania, przeglądów kodu i dokumentacji.
Dbanie o wysokie standardy bezpieczeństwa, ochronę danych i zgodność rozwiązań z wymaganiami GDPR.

Dodatkowy zakres odpowiedzialności dla ścieżki mobilnej

Projektowanie architektury aplikacji mobilnych na iOS i Android.
Dobór właściwego podejścia: rozwiązania natywne, cross-platformowe lub hybrydowe.
Projektowanie integracji aplikacji mobilnych z API, usługami backendowymi i systemami zewnętrznymi.
Nadzór nad bezpieczeństwem, wydajnością, pracą offline, przechowywaniem danych i integracją z funkcjami urządzeń mobilnych.
Wspieranie zespołów w publikowaniu, utrzymaniu i rozwoju aplikacji produkcyjnych.

Od Kandydata Oczekujemy

Minimum 4 lata doświadczenia w roli obejmującej odpowiedzialność architektoniczną lub techniczne prowadzenie projektów, np. Solution Architect, Software Architect, Tech Lead lub Senior Developer.
Wieloletnie, praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu i wdrażaniu aplikacji.
Umiejętność projektowania kompletnych rozwiązań end-to-end, a nie wyłącznie pojedynczych komponentów.
Bardzo dobra znajomość wzorców projektowych, clean architecture, zasad clean code oraz modularnego projektowania systemów.
Doświadczenie w projektowaniu API, integracji z systemami zewnętrznymi i rozwiązaniami backendowymi.
Znajomość procesów CI/CD, automatyzacji testów, code review oraz praktyk zapewniania jakości.
Doświadczenie z architekturą chmurową, np. AWS, Azure lub Google Cloud Platform.
Umiejętność oceny kompromisów pomiędzy wartością biznesową, czasem realizacji, kosztami i złożonością techniczną.
Doświadczenie w prowadzeniu technicznych warsztatów, spotkań z klientami lub prezentacji rozwiązań.
Umiejętność komunikowania zagadnień technicznych zarówno zespołom developerskim, jak i interesariuszom biznesowym.
Doświadczenie w pracy w metodykach Agile/Scrum.
Bardzo dobra znajomość języka angielskiego, minimum B2, umożliwiająca swobodną pracę z klientami i międzynarodowymi zespołami.

Wymagania specjalistyczne

Bardzo dobra znajomość architektury aplikacji mobilnych.
Praktyczne doświadczenie w tworzeniu aplikacji natywnych na iOS lub Android.
Znajomość technologii takich jak Swift i SwiftUI, Kotlin, Flutter, React Native lub Kotlin Multiplatform.
Dobre rozumienie różnic pomiędzy rozwiązaniami natywnymi i cross-platformowymi oraz ich wpływu na wydajność, bezpieczeństwo, utrzymanie i rozwój produktu.
Doświadczenie w publikowaniu, utrzymaniu i rozwijaniu aplikacji produkcyjnych.
Znajomość zagadnień związanych z wydajnością aplikacji, bezpieczeństwem urządzeń mobilnych, przechowywaniem danych, pracą offline i integracją z API.
Szczególnie cenione będzie doświadczenie architektoniczne we Flutterze połączone z dobrym rozumieniem natywnego iOS oraz Androida.

Mile Widziane

Doświadczenie w software house, agencji digital lub firmie realizującej projekty dla zewnętrznych klientów.
Praca przy projektach realizowanych w modelu fixed price.
Doświadczenie w tworzeniu proof of concept i technicznych prototypów.
Praktyczna znajomość narzędzi wspierających development przy użyciu AI.
Doświadczenie w projektach realizowanych przez rozproszone, międzynarodowe zespoły.

Proponujemy

Stabilną i długofalową współpracę w oparciu o umowę o pracę lub kontrakt B2B.
Model hybrydowy - pracę z biura w Gdańsku we wtorki i czwartki.
Udział w międzynarodowych projektach dla rozpoznawalnych klientów.
Realny wpływ na architekturę, wybór technologii i sposób realizacji projektów.
Możliwość łączenia pracy architektonicznej, technicznego leadershipu i współpracy z klientami.
Współpracę z doświadczonymi zespołami developerskimi, projektowymi i produktowymi.
Środowisko otwarte na nowe technologie, usprawnienia i inicjatywę.
Prywatną opiekę medyczną, kartę Multisport oraz dofinansowanie nauki języków.

Our client is an established technology consultancy founded in 2010, with a portfolio of more than 500 completed projects. The company focuses on digital strategy, UX/UI design, and the development of mobile apps, web platforms and AI-driven agents. They help organizations build cohesive digital ecosystems by combining creative design with robust engineering practices. Flexible engagement models — project teams, dedicated squads and on-demand digital specialists — enable tailored delivery to match client needs and timelines. The culture emphasizes collaboration, high-quality user experiences and tangible business outcomes. Currently recruiting digital experts: UX/UI designers, mobile engineers, web developers and AI specialists eager to create advanced digital products on modern platforms. This is a compelling opportunity for professionals who value innovation, teamwork and direct impact on client-facing digital solutions.

Web Solution Architect

location: Gdańsk

Responsibilities

Analysis of business needs and functional and non-functional requirements.
Designing target solution architecture, integration approach, data flow and communication with external systems.
Designing scalable integrations, APIs and cross-platform solutions.
Making and justifying decisions regarding technologies, frameworks, libraries and tools.
Assessing impact of architectural decisions on performance, security, maintainability, scalability and implementation cost.
Preparing architectural documentation, diagrams, technical standards and recommendations for teams.
Conducting discovery conversations with clients and identifying real needs, constraints and risks.
Presenting proposed architecture, technological solutions and estimations.
Supporting preparation of proposals, estimations, responses to tenders and RFPs.
Technical leadership of development teams throughout the project lifecycle.
Organizing the technical part of Sprint 0, including preparation of environments, repositories, CI/CD, coding, testing and security standards.
Defining and enforcing clean code standards, good architectural practices and quality principles.
Conducting architecture reviews and supporting the team during code reviews.
Mentoring less experienced team members and supporting them in solving difficult technical problems.
Identifying technical risks and communicating them to project stakeholders.
Collaborating with UX/UI, QA, backend, frontend, mobile, DevOps and Delivery teams.
Supporting responsible use of AI tools in development, testing, code reviews and documentation.
Ensuring high standards of security, data protection and compliance of solutions with GDPR requirements.
Designing architecture of modern web applications.
Designing collaboration between frontend, backend, APIs and cloud services.
Modernizing existing systems, refactoring and migrating legacy solutions.
Overseeing performance, security of web applications, caching, monitoring and technical debt.

Position Requirements

Minimum 4 years of experience in a role involving architectural responsibility or technical project leadership, e.g., Solution Architect, Software Architect, Tech Lead, or Senior Developer.
Many years of practical experience in building and deploying applications.
Ability to design complete end-to-end solutions, not just individual components.
Very good knowledge of design patterns, clean architecture, clean code principles, and modular system design.
Experience in designing APIs, integrating with external systems, and backend solutions.
Familiarity with CI/CD processes, test automation, code review, and quality assurance practices.
Experience with cloud architecture, e.g., AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.
Ability to assess trade-offs between business value, delivery time, costs, and technical complexity.
Experience in conducting technical workshops, client meetings, or solution presentations.
Ability to communicate technical matters to both development teams and business stakeholders.
Experience working in Agile/Scrum methodologies.
Very good command of English, minimum B2, enabling smooth work with clients and international teams.

jobs.description:
We are looking for an experienced software engineer to join the team responsible for developing the software platforms underlying COMSOL Multiphysics®. You will work with the runtimes, libraries, build systems, and platform integrations that form the foundation of a large, cross-platform engineering software product. The majority of the development is done in Java and C#, together with build and automation tooling.About COMSOLCOMSOL develops cutting-edge mathematical modeling software that powers innovations in physics and engineering. Our flagship product, COMSOL Multiphysics®, is widely used across all fields of engineering, manufacturing, and scientific research to model multiphysics systems. Our customers leverage our software to understand, predict, and optimize product designs and processes. Founded in Sweden in 1986, COMSOL has expanded globally with 16 offices employing more than 500 people worldwide.RoleBased in our newly renovated office in central Stockholm, you will join the core group developing the user interface, communication, and data layer functionality of the COMSOL product suite. The group is also responsible for the Application Builder, Model Manager, COMSOL Server, and COMSOL Compiler functionality, which customers use to create, manage, deploy, and run simulation models and apps.In this role, you will work on several of the software platforms on which our products are built. This includes the Java and .NET runtimes and their ecosystems, third-party libraries, database connectivity and persistence technologies, application launchers, build systems, and integration of vendored software. The work spans multiple operating systems and a large codebase with a long development history.You will evaluate and integrate new runtime and library versions, investigate compatibility issues, implement or backport APIs and other changes where needed, and develop automation that makes recurring platform and dependency work more efficient and reliable.The role also provides opportunities to evolve the platforms themselves. Depending on your experience and interests, this can include introducing new platform capabilities and APIs, improving how runtimes and third-party components are integrated, evolving build and development infrastructure, and finding better ways to support development across the product organization. You will have room to identify improvements and contribute to the longer-term technical direction of the areas you work with.Responsibilities include writing and reviewing code, investigating platform and compatibility issues, contributing to technical specifications and design, developing build and platform infrastructure, and testing changes across the supported product platforms.QualificationsFor this position, we are looking for an experienced software engineer with the following qualifications:

M.Sc. or equivalent degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics, or physics.
Excellent programming skills with proficiency in at least one object-oriented programming language.
Several years of professional software development experience.
An interest in working with complex software systems and improving the technical foundations on which other development depends.

Experience with the following will be highly valued:

Large software projects and mature codebases.
Java and/or .NET runtime environments and their library ecosystems.
Build systems, dependency management, and software packaging.
Cross-platform development on Windows, Linux, and macOS.
Integrating or adapting third-party and open-source software.
Build and development automation.
Designing or evolving software platforms, frameworks, or developer infrastructure.

No background in physics or simulation is required. At COMSOL, you will be part of a company where software developers, mathematicians, physicists, and engineers work together to develop software for science and engineering.Working at COMSOLAt COMSOL, platform engineering is closely connected to product development. You will work on technical foundations used throughout the COMSOL product suite, with opportunities both to ensure that those foundations remain robust and current and to improve how they support future product development. Decisions about runtimes, libraries, build systems, and operating-system support have a direct impact on a complex engineering product with a long lifetime.New team members quickly become essential contributors to ongoing development projects. As the company continues to expand, there are plenty of opportunities for employees to advance in their roles and become leading experts in their areas of focus. This journey will be accompanied by experienced colleagues and a collaborative working environment.We also offer:

A competitive salary
Individual pension plans
Sponsored gym membership
Work-life balance with regular working hours

RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Vill du vara med och leda utvecklingen av mjukvara som gör skillnad för cancerpatienter världen över? 

På RaySearch kombinerar vi avancerad teknik med ett tydligt syfte: att förbättra cancervården genom innovativ mjukvara som används på cancerkliniker världen över. Hos oss får du möjlighet att kombinera ett starkt teknikintresse med ett meningsfullt uppdrag, där ditt ledarskap bidrar till att göra skillnad för människor varje dag.

Nu genomför vi en förändring inom vår utvecklingsorganisation och söker två erfarna ledare till våra nya sektioner Application Development 1 och Application Development 2. Rollerna är centrala i arbetet med att stärka och vidareutveckla vår applikationsutveckling. Tillsammans ansvarar ni för att bygga en stark, skalbar och högpresterande utvecklingsorganisation med fokus på förbättringsarbete, kompetensutveckling, samarbete och leverans. Som en del av vår nya linjeorganisation med fem sektioner inom utvecklingsavdelningen kommer ni att arbeta nära de övriga sektionerna som ansvarar för produktutvecklingens inriktning och genomförande, produkternas säkerhet och validering samt fysik och algoritmutveckling.

Om rollen

Som Head of Application Development ansvarar du för att utveckla organisationen bakom RaySearchs produkter vilka inkluderar RayStation, ett avancerat dosplaneringssystem för strålbehandling, och RayCare, ett innovativt onkologiskt informationssystem som stödjer hela cancerbehandlingsprocessen. Vi arbetar med en modern teknikstack som bland annat omfattar C#, .NET, SQL Server, WPF och React.

Du rapporterar till Director of Development och leder ett antal gruppchefer. Hur ansvar och direktrapporter fördelas mellan de två rollerna avgörs utifrån verksamhetens behov och de personer som tillträder tjänsterna. Ni arbetar nära varandra för att utveckla både era sektioner och avdelningen som helhet.

I rollen som Head of Application Development leder du arbetet med att sätta riktningen för applikationsutvecklingen och ser till att organisationen har förmågan att omsätta den i väl fungerande produkter. Det innebär bland annat att:

•  Utforma och kommunicera strategi för mjukvaruarkitektur, designprinciper och teknisk inriktning.

•  Skapa arbetssätt och styrning som bidrar till hög kvalitet och lösningar som är enkla att vidareutveckla och kan växa med behoven.

•  Driva förbättringsarbete kring utvecklingsprocesser, verktyg, utvecklarnas produktivitet och användningen av AI. 

•  Bygga långsiktig teknisk kompetens utifrån verksamhetens och produkternas behov.

•  Säkerställa rätt bemanning, kompetens och organisatoriska förutsättningar för framgångsrik produktutveckling.

•  Stärka samarbetet mellan team och funktioner så att gemensamma prioriteringar får genomslag.

•  Leda och utveckla chefer och tekniska ledare.

Din profil

Experience working with and integrating AI within software tools is a plus.

jobs.description:
About Planet

Planet is a global provider of integrated technology and payments solutions for retail and hospitality customers.

We create great experiences for the millions of people who use our payments, software, and tax-free solutions every minute of every day.

Planet empowers its customers to deliver great customer experiences by combining payments and software in ways that drive greater loyalty, increase revenue and save time.

Founded over 35 years ago and with our headquarters in London, today we have more than 2,500 employees located across six continents serving our customers in more than 120 markets.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled Cloud Operations Engineer with deep expertise in Microsoft Azure networking to join our Cloud & Infrastructure Services team. The ideal candidate will operate, secure, troubleshoot, and continuously improve cloud and hybrid network services that support business-critical platforms.

This role combines strong cloud operations capability with advanced knowledge of network architecture and protocols. The successful candidate will take ownership of Azure connectivity and network security services, support hybrid connectivity with on-premises and other cloud environments, automate network deployment and configuration, and lead the diagnosis and resolution of complex connectivity and performance issues.

Previous experience working within regulated industries (e.g., payments, financial services, PCI-DSS, healthcare, or other compliance-driven environments) is highly desirable.

What You Will Do

Operate, maintain, and improve highly available Azure and hybrid cloud network services.
Design and support Azure hub-and-spoke and Virtual WAN architectures, virtual networks, subnets, peering, user-defined routes, NAT Gateway, Private Link, private endpoints, and service endpoints.
Manage network security controls including Network Security Groups, Azure Firewall, Web Application Firewall, DDoS Protection, network segmentation, and controlled ingress and egress.
Operate hybrid connectivity using ExpressRoute, site-to-site and point-to-site VPNs, BGP, and integration with on-premises routing and security platforms.
Support Azure DNS, Private DNS, DNS forwarding and resolution across hybrid environments, and application delivery through Azure Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and third-party appliances.
Develop and maintain Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, applying peer review, testing, and controlled deployment practices to network changes.
Monitor network health, flow, latency, availability, capacity, and security signals using Azure Monitor, Network Watcher, logs, and observability platforms.
Troubleshoot complex issues across DNS, routing, firewalls, load balancing, TLS, connectivity, and application network paths.
Lead or support incident response, root cause analysis, problem management, maintenance, and service restoration for production infrastructure.
Collaborate with security, platform engineering, application, and enterprise network teams to deliver secure and reliable connectivity.
Maintain network documentation, diagrams, operational procedures, standards, and runbooks, and contribute to disaster recovery and capacity planning.

Who You Are

Extensive hands-on experience operating Microsoft Azure infrastructure, with advanced expertise in Azure networking.
Strong knowledge of TCP/IP, IPv4 addressing and subnetting, DNS, DHCP, NAT, routing, BGP, VPNs, proxies, load balancing, TLS, and network security principles.
Deep experience with Azure Virtual Network, peering, routing, NSGs, Azure Firewall, Private Link, Private DNS, ExpressRoute, VPN Gateway, Load Balancer, Application Gateway, Front Door, and Network Watcher.
Proven ability to troubleshoot end-to-end connectivity and performance across cloud, on-premises, and hybrid environments using packet captures, flow logs, route analysis, DNS tools, and platform telemetry.
Experience with enterprise firewalls, network virtual appliances, web application firewalls, and traffic management technologies.
Experience using Terraform for repeatable, controlled Infrastructure as Code deployments.
Experience operating production services, responding to incidents, managing changes, and completing root cause analysis.
Scripting and automation experience using PowerShell, Azure CLI, Bash, Python, or similar technologies.
Clear communication skills and the ability to produce accurate technical documentation and explain complex network issues to technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

Experience with Fortinet, F5, or comparable enterprise firewall and application delivery platforms.
Experience with Azure Virtual WAN, Azure Route Server, multi-region connectivity, and multi-cloud networking.
Knowledge of Zero Trust networking, PCI-DSS controls, and network segmentation in regulated environments.
Experience with monitoring and observability platforms and analysis of network and security telemetry.

Preferred Experience

Experience working in regulated environments such as payments, financial services, banking, healthcare, or other compliance-driven industries.
Relevant certifications such as Azure Network Engineer Associate, Azure Administrator Associate, Azure Solutions Architect Expert, or recognized enterprise networking certifications.

On-Call Requirements

This position supports business-critical production infrastructure and network services. Participation in an on-call rotation is expected, and candidates must be willing to provide out-of-hours support for connectivity incidents, security events, maintenance activities, and service restoration.

Why Planet

Planet is an equal opportunity employer where diversity is valued, and all employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business need.

Come and grow your career in the most exciting, fast paced technology market, with a business that delivers feel-good connected commerce.

We would love to hear from you – Apply now
.

At Planet, we embrace a hybrid work model, with three days a week in the office.

Reasonable accommodations may be made in order to allow for an individual to perform the essential functions of this role successfully.

You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience

vahvistamaan asiantuntijatiimiämme, joka toteuttaa merkittäviä digitalisaatiohankkeita. Tarjoamme sinulle mahdollisuuden työskennellä monipuolisissa asiakasprojekteissa, joissa pääset vaikuttamaan teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja kehittämään omaa osaamistasi.

Sijainti:
Tampere, Helsinki, Jyväskylä, Turku, Oulu tai Lappeenranta. Voit myös halutessasi työskennellä etänä kotoa, mutta asiakkaan turvallisuusvaatimusten vuoksi osa työtehtävistä on suoritettava toimistolla tai asiakkaan tiloissa Helsingissä.

Vastuualueet:

Sovelluskehittäjänä:

Työskentelet monipuolisesti suomalaisen julkishallinnon ja yksityisen elinkeinoelämän asiakasprojekteissa kehittäen moderneja, skaalautuvia sovelluksia.
Osallistut mikropalveluarkkitehtuurien suunnitteluun ja toteutukseen.
Toimit osana asiantuntijatiimiä, jossa yhdistyvät kehittäjät, arkkitehdit, analyytikot ja UX/UI-suunnittelijat.
Ohjaat asiakasta parhaisiin ratkaisuihin ja osallistut aktiivisesti tekniseen suunnitteluun.
Toimit tiimissä osana suurempaa monen tiimin hanketta.

Kenen kanssa työskentelet?

Työskentelet osana T woday Digital Engineering asiantuntevaa noin 350 hengen praktiikkaa. Meillä on Suomen kärkitason osaajia ja rooleja devaajista arkkitehteihin sekä konsultteihin.

Tarjoamme sinulle osaavan, rennon ja innokkaan työympäristön, jossa sinun on mahdollista kehittää ammatillista osaamistasi ja vaikuttaa omaan urapolkuusi. Työkulttuuriamme kuvaa avoin ja välittävä asenne työntekijöitämme kohtaan.

Odotamme sinulta:

Vähintään 3 vuoden kokemus.
Osaamista seuraavista teknologioista: C#, .NET, Vue, React, TypeScript.
Tuntemusta relaatiotietokannoista kuten PostgreSQL, MariaDB tai Oracle.
Pilviosaamista: Azure tai AWS.
Kokemusta mikropalveluarkkitehtuureista ja kontitetuista ratkaisuista.
Kokemusta ketterästä sovelluskehityksestä.
Sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa ja vakituinen asuinpaikka Suomessa.
Englannin kielen osaaminen.
Olet oma-aloitteinen ja sinulla on kyky viedä asioita eteenpäin.
Olet sopivasti ulospäin suuntautunut persoona ja osaat toimia osana tiimiä.
Kykenet organisoimaan sekä priorisoimaan omaa työtäsi.
Uskallat esittää asiat kuten ne ovat.
Osaat antaa rakentavaa palautetta ja kehittää tiimin toimintaa jatkuvasti.
Sinulla on vähintään alempi korkeakoulututkinto suoritettuna.
Olet taustaltasi nuhteeton, koska tehtävään valittavasta henkilöstä asiakkaamme vaativat perusmuotoisen henkilöturvallisuusselvityksen, jotta asiakasprojektiin osallistuminen olisi mahdollista. Lisätietoa turvallisuusselvityksestä ja sen vaatimuksista.

Katsomme eduksi

Jos sinulla on kokemusta jostain seuraavista osaamisista:

Kokemusta WMS / RabbitMQ
Skaalatusta ketterästä kehityksestä (esim. SAFe).
Turvaverkoista (Tuve).
Integraatioista.
Julkisen organisaation hankkeista.
Standardi / EU dokumentaation ymmärrys.
Viranomaisdokumentaation ymmärrys.

Meille on tärkeää, että osaat toimia osana tiimiä ja kommunikoit aktiivisesti sekä avoimesti, olet asiakaspalveluhenkinen. Haluat tehdä työsi laadukkaasti ja oikein. Olet innokas kehittämään ja haastamaan itsesi sekä tiimisi can-do -asenteella.

Miltä onnistuminen roolissa näyttää?

Ensimmäisen kuuden kuukauden tavoitteesi kiteytettynä:

Olet läpäissyt turvallisuusselvityksen.
Olet päässyt hyvin osaksi työyhteisöä ja osoittautunut loistavaksi lisäksi tiimiimme.
Olet sisäistänyt asiakkaan toimialan ja perehtynyt sisään hankkeeseen.
Osaamisesi on osoittautunut relevantiksi asiakasprojekteissamme.

Auttaaksemme sinua menestymään, tarjoamme sinulle perehdytysohjelman, koulutuksia, sertifikaatteja sekä työyhteisön, joka omalla osaamisellaan ja tekemisellään tukee työssä oppimistasi ja urakehitystäsi. Lisäksi inklusiivinen kulttuurimme tarjoaa useita mahdollisuuksia tutustua uusiin työkavereihin sekä työn että hauskanpidon merkeissä.

Mitä Twoday tarjoaa sinulle?

Jäykkien organisaatiorakenteiden ja korkean hierarkian sijaan yksikkömme tarjoaa sinulle autonomiaa ja joustavuutta tukevan työympäristön.

Etuihimme kuuluu:

Markkinatasoinen työsuhde-etujen paketti sisältäen:
Lounas ja virike-etu
Työterveyshuolto
Auntie mielen hyvinvoinnin tukipalvelut
Mahdollisuus valita omat työvälineesi

Vahva tuki ammatilliselle kehittymiselle:
Online-oppimisympäristöt: Udemy
Teknologiasertifioinnit, joista toisinaan palkitaan myös bonuksin
Koulutukset ja community-tapaamiset
Yhteisölliset oppimissessiot työkavereiden kanssa (esim. hackathon tapahtumat)

Paljon vapaa-ajan aktiviteetteja, kuten:
Koko firman tapahtumat
Toimitustiimien omat tapahtumat
Kaikille avoimia ja vapaasti perustettavia harrastekerhoja, mm. maastopyöräily, juoksu, lautapelit, neulonta, e-urheilu, padel.

Tehtävään hakeminen:

Voit hakea tehtävään helposti LinkedIn-profiilillasi tai CV:llä. Hakemuskirje on vapaaehtoinen. Palaamme sinulle mahdollisimman pian!

Paikka täytetään heti, kun sopiva henkilö löytyy.

Huomioithan, että voimme edetä ainoastaan hakijoiden kanssa, joilla on työntekoon oikeuttava oleskelulupa Suomessa.

Työskentely Twodaylla

Twoday on johtava teknologiakonsultointiyritys, joka auttaa organisaatioita hyödyntämään tekoälyä ja edistyksellisiä teknologioita käytännössä. Meitä on noin 2 300 asiantuntijaa tekoälyn, datan, digitaalisen kehityksen ja pilvipalveluiden parissa. Autamme asiakkaitamme selkeyttämään monimutkaisia kokonaisuuksia, vähentämään epävarmuutta ja saamaan teknologiasta konkreettista liiketoimintahyötyä.

Tarkoituksemme on rakentaa parempaa huomista tekoälyn ja teknologian avulla. Tuemme niin yksityisen kuin julkisen sektorin organisaatioita muun muassa energia- ja yhdyskuntatekniikan alalla, finanssi- ja vakuutussektorilla, teollisuudessa, terveydenhuollossa sekä julkishallinnossa.

Suurin vahvuutemme ei kuitenkaan ole teknologia, vaan ihmiset sen takana. Joka päivä asiantuntijamme hyödyntävät osaamistaan, uteliaisuuttaan ja määrätietoisuuttaan auttaakseen asiakkaitamme ratkaisemaan monimutkaisia haasteita ja luomaan kestävää arvoa.

Monimuotoisuus ja yhdenvertaisuus

Haluamme rakentaa työyhteisön, jossa jokaista arvostetaan ja jossa kaikilla on yhtäläiset mahdollisuudet menestyä. Rekrytointipäätöksemme perustuvat osaamiseen, kokemukseen ja henkilön soveltuvuuteen tehtävään.

Etkö täytä kaikkia vaatimuksia?

Moni jättää hakematta, jos ei koe täyttävänsä jokaista ilmoituksessa mainittua kriteeriä. Meille tärkeintä on, että sinulla on tehtävässä tarvittavaa osaamista, aitoa kiinnostusta rooliin sekä halua kehittyä. Jos tehtävä herättää mielenkiintosi ja uskot voivasi menestyä siinä, kannustamme sinua hakemaan.

jobs.title: Integration Engineer
jobs.description:
Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. We co-create the solutions, infrastructure, and adoption that make it stick. What brings us together is deep technical expertise, a creative engineering mindset, and a people-first culture. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC.

We are now looking for a Integration Engineer
to strengthen our team in Helsinki. In this role, you will design, build, and maintain integration solutions that connect cloud services, enterprise systems, and business-critical applications. You will work closely with customers and internal delivery teams to ensure integrations are reliable, secure, and scalable.

The role combines hands-on technical work with responsibility for contributing to and shaping integration architectures that support long-term business needs. You will take an active role across the full lifecycle of integration projects, from solution design and implementation to deployment and continuous improvement.

In this role, you will

Design and implement API based and event driven integration solutions
Design integration solutions following Azure best practices and cloud native patterns
Build integrations using Azure Integration Services such as Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, and Event Hubs
Develop and maintain integrations using C# and the .NET ecosystem
Apply Infrastructure as Code practices using tools such as Terraform
Ensure secure authentication, authorization, and API security using OAuth and best practices
Collaborate with architects, developers, and customers to design end to end integration solutions
Support deployments, monitoring, and continuous improvement of integration platforms, ensuring reliability and observability in production environments

What We’re Looking For

3+ years of experience in API and integration development
Strong expertise in Azure Integration Services (Logic Apps, Functions, API Management, Service Bus, Event Hubs)
Hands on experience with Infrastructure as Code (tools such as Terraform)
Good understanding of OAuth authentication and API security best practices
Ability to take ownership of integration solutions and make technical decisions in customer projects
Experience with C# programming and the .NET ecosystem, particularly when building Azure Functions or custom integration components
Fluency in both Finnish and English
Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work both independently and as part of a team

Nice to have

Microsoft certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Developer Associate
Experience with DevOps practices and CI/CD pipelines
Expertise in BizTalk
Previous experience delivering or managing integrations in large organizations
Broader data engineering development experience to contribute to both integration and data projects

Why Norrin?

At Norrin, you'll join an international team
of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with Nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges
keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.

We invest in continuous learning
through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities
where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you.

We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect
, with psychological safety at its core .
As a member of the Women in Tech network, we're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.

Our hybrid working model
combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we offer comprehensive benefits
, including extensive occupational healthcare and dental care, insurance coverage, regular massages, and culture and sports benefits. Our compensation model includes a competitive base salary, a performance-based bonus
, and the opportunity to participate in an employee fund.

Could this be your next opportunity?

We’re excited to hear from you! Submit your application as soon as possible, as we will review applications on an ongoing basis and move forward as soon as we find the right match.

jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
We are looking for a Software Architect who designs comprehensive technical solutions to bridge business problems with technology, ensuring alignment with organizational goals, security, and scalability. In your work you create architecture blueprints, select technology stacks, and lead implementation teams, acting as a crucial link between stakeholders and developers.

The role is based in our Espoo or Tampere office, and the work will be done in a hybrid model according to our needs.

Your Main Responsibilities

Sales and presales: Identifying customer needs and proposing bold solutions.
Architecture Design: Creating detailed architecture specifications, diagrams, and documentation for software and infrastructure.
Strategic Alignment: Mapping business requirements to technical solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and security.
Technology Selection: Evaluating and recommending tools, platforms, and frameworks that align with technical strategies.
Implementation Oversight: Guiding development teams during implementation to ensure adherence to the designed architecture.
Stakeholder Management: Communicating technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders and acting as a bridge between teams.

Your Required Skills And Experience

Technical Expertise: Strong background in software engineering (minimum 10 years), system integration, infrastructure, and cloud technologies (e.g., Azure, AWS).
Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills to explain complex concepts to diverse audiences.
Problem-Solving: Strong analytical skills to diagnose complex problems and design effective, creative solutions.
Leadership: Ability and proven track-record in leading teams and guiding technical decision-making.
Project Management: Experience with SDLC, Agile methodologies, and managing project risks.
A Master’s degree in computer science or related field.
Extensive experience in software design, development, and IT infrastructure.
Experience in a technical leadership role.
Language skills: fluent English and Finnish

We also value

Entrepreneurial mindset
Deeper domain knowledge of industrial manufacturing

At Etteplan we ensure that your compensation is fair and transparent. Your salary reflects your competencies and contributions, in line with our way of working. For this role, the typical monthly salary is 6000-7000€/month, depending on your background.

jobs.title: Join BELLA Intelligence as a Software Developer
jobs.location: Copenhagen, Capital Region of Denmark, Denmark
jobs.description:
BELLA Intelligence is a niche software platform for insolvency case management, and part of Karnov Group. You don’t need to be a legal expert—or an Ace Attorney—to make an impact here. If you’re a Software Developer seeking a place with talented colleagues, meaningful technical challenges, and a supportive culture, this opportunity is for you. Keep reading to learn more about the role and why BELLA could be your next great move.

The Role

We’re looking for a developer with a user-centric mindset and a drive to evolve the product in step with the market, execute our roadmap, and meet client expectations. You’ll work with modern technologies and have a significant opportunity to grow, diversify your skill set, and contribute to an exciting growth journey.

You’ll work across the full stack and the end-to-end development lifecycle—UX/UI, coding, testing, debugging, and more. You’ll also contribute to broader business topics at BELLA, including the product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and domain-specific decisions. Collaboration is central: you’ll partner with the BELLA team to share progress and tackle challenges, and work with developers to refine requirements, design solutions, and deliver new features.

The Stack 

.NET
Front-end: React with TypeScript
Database: Microsoft SQL

Must Have

Minimum 3 years of experience working with .NET. (Preference for .NET Framework however .NET Core will also work)
Strong English skills in reading, writing and speaking
Strong communication skills
Business understanding, enabling you to consult and contribute to BELLA’s product roadmap, IT infrastructure, and other domain-specific topics.
A curiosity and eagerness to stay up to date with the latest software developments, trends, and technologies
Strong collaborative skills

Nice to Have 

Entity Framework
HTML
CSS
RxJS
Redux
Azure

About BELLA Intelligence

BELLA Intelligence, part of Karnov Group, is a cloud-based SaaS platform that streamlines daily workflows for managing insolvency cases. Our service includes secure hosting of case-related data.

We’re a small, flat, and highly transparent team with a strong professional culture. BELLA Intelligence is the market leader in its niche in Denmark, and we’re on a growth journey—focused on delivering business-critical functionality, reducing time to value, and accelerating our expansion into Sweden.

About Karnov 

Karnov Group is a leading provider of critical legal, tax, and compliance information across Denmark, Sweden, Norway, France, Spain, and Portugal. We’re in the midst of an exciting transformation — evolving from a traditional publisher into a modern technology company. 

Throughout the entire Karnov Group we work on a foundation of trust and transparency, and psychological safety is a key value in our culture. You’ll work alongside talented colleagues who support each other and share a drive to build the best tools possible for our customers. We’re located right by Nørreport Station in central Copenhagen. We offer great flexibility and expect you to take ownership and responsibility together with your team. We have a common-sense driven hybrid remote policy.

Apply

Interested? Reach out to Kenan Jugo, Commercial Director, Portfolio Companies, at kenan.jugo@karnovgroup.com . We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis and will hire as soon as we find the right candidate. We look forward to hearing from you.

Visier is the global leader in Workforce Intelligence that powers every people decision. We bring Workforce AI to life for HR departments through our award-winning, agentic AI technology by surfacing the insights leaders need to plan, decide, and act with confidence in the moments that matter most. As the market leader in people analytics, workforce planning, organizational design, and manager effectiveness solutions, we fuel smarter decision-making for organizations across the globe. Our mission is to help businesses lead with insight at scale as they continuously transform.

Founded in 2010 by the pioneers of business intelligence, we have over 85,000 customers in 75 countries—including enterprises like BASF, Panasonic, Domino’s Pizza, Experian, Amgen, eBay, and Ford Motor Company.

Visier is the leader in people analytics and we believe in a 'people-first' approach to business strategy. Our innovative technology transforms the way that organisations make decisions, allowing them to elevate their employees and drive better business outcomes. Embarking on an exciting new chapter in our growth story, we are looking for talented individuals who can help both Visier and our customers grow, evolve and win!

Visier is recruiting for a Software Developer Intern to join our innovative and extremely talented Development department.

Our internship experience is unique and designed to prepare you for professional success as you work on real, impactful work from the beginning...not features that may be mothballed after a few months of hard work! Our ultimate goal is to give you the mentorship, training, and work experience you need to start your career. A number of our students return to us after they graduate and start developing their professional career at Visier!

And we use cool state-of-the-art technology to build our innovative full-stack software solution that helps people see the truth and drives organizations to perform their best. We use a variety of frontend technologies including Angular, React, NgRx, Play Framework, TypeScript, Less, and others. We deal with large volumes of data every day. And in our backend areas we work with technologies like Scala, Kotlin, Python, Kafka, Spark, Consul, Cassandra DB, Docker, AWS, etc. We work with LLMs, various prompt engineering techniques and related technologies such as LangChain. So, you’ll be developing knowledge and skills that are transferable anywhere.

What You'll Be Doing...

Writing production level code that will directly impact customers
Implementing cool new features
Fixing complex bugs
Writing tests
Collaborating with people in all stages of the software development cycle

What You'll Bring To The Table...

Coding skills in relevant programming languages (for example, like Java, Python, JavaScript, Typescript, Scala, or other similar languages)
Knowledge of data structures and algorithms
Knowledge of one of the following areas would be an advantage:
LLMs
Web technologies (REST, HTML/CSS, JSON, Angular)
Relational and non-relational databases and SQL language

Coding skills in writing functional tests
Attention to detail, tendency to spot mistakes and identify potential improvements

Most importantly, you share our values...

You roll up your sleeves
You make it easy
You are proud
You never stop learning
You play to win

jobs.description:

Accenture Industry X, part of Accenture, helps businesses thrive in the digital era by combining data and digital capabilities. Join us to experience how we deliver 360 value and collaborate with exceptional people, cutting-edge technology, and leading companies across various industries, making a significant impact worldwide.

We are working in the domain of Manufacturing Execution Systems
, which means that the solutions we are working on are directly impacting how factories around the world are managing their manufacturing processes.

Our team is responsible for the end-to-end MES project implementations
, which includes both solution analysis (assessment, requirements, process design, solution design) and solution implementation (configuration, development, testing).

Our clients are coming from a variety of industries, manufacturing products which we sometimes use on daily basis: toys, cars, tires, car components, furniture, medical devices, medicine, etc.

We are looking for an ambitious MES Implementation Engineer
ready to take on new challenges. As industries head towards Manufacturing and Factory Digitalization, MES systems stand in the center of manufacturing excellence.

As a Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) Implementation Engineer
, you will be responsible for the development and integration of project specific MES systems to enhance cutting edge process automation solutions meeting customer requirements.

Job Description:

Get familiar with one or more MES solutions provided by our partners

Development, configuration, testing and deployment of the MES solution

Write well-designed, testable, efficient code

Work as part of a local or geographically distributed team

Responsible for MES software integration with systems like ERP, PLM, APS, LIMS and other Control Systems

Building custom reports using various reporting tools

Work every day in an Agile Environment, using the Scrum methodology

Short-term project-based business travel when required

Bachelor/MS of Computer Science / Engineering or equivalent exposure to the IT industry

+2 years experience developing database driven web sites/applications

+3 years work experience on factory MES, automation and process control systems in a manufacturing environment

Solid technical/functional experience with MES systems (preferred: Opcenter Execution Process Enterprise) or other Manufacturing related software is an advantage

Proven success in contributing to a team-oriented, multicultural environment

Proven ability to work creatively and analytically in a problem-solving environment

Effective organization and prioritization skills

Knowledge of cross-platform and cross-browser web development, constraints and issues

Functional knowledge in any of the following: Production, Quality, Maintenance, Inventory

Excelent communication and collaboration skills - both written and verbal

Fluency in English, knowledge of other foreign languages is considered a plus

Professional Skill Requirements:

Experienced in using and maintaining RDBMS like Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle and MySQL (SQL, backups, stored procedures, functions)

Practical experience in software development using C#, ASP.NET or Java

Front-End Web-Development skills with strong focus on HTML, CSS, JavaScript and JQuery

Previous project experience involving Development, Configuration, Implementation for different manufacturing industries is considered a plus

Experience working in a Windows Server/IIS environment

Experience in MES - ERP (or other manufacturing related software) integration is considered an advantage

Knowledge of ISA-95/ MESA/ SCOR standards is considered an advantage

At Accenture, we prioritize your health and well-being through comprehensive health insurance coverage and inclusive work arrangements. We value your growth and offer diverse learning and development paths, along with performance-based rewards. You'll also have access to resources for mental health and physical wellness, ensuring inclusivity and support. jobs.title: Senior Backend Developer
jobs.description:
The Impact You'll Make

Danfoss Group IT is seeking an experienced developer
to forefront our integration initiatives and drive the continued improvement of our application portfolio in Azure cloud.
In this pivotal role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and deploying robust and scalable enterprise-level integrations.

You will be part of the Digital Customer Experience (DCE) team, with more than 125 international colleagues, where we develop, support, and lead the digital customer experience in Danfoss. We connect business needs and IT into digital solutions.

jobs.description:
Job Requisition ID #

26WD100450

Position Overview

Autodesk is looking for a Software Quality Assurance Engineer / Software Engineer in Test
to join the Autodesk Revit Cloud Worksharing team.

Autodesk Revit is world-leading Building Information Modeling (BIM) software used by architects, engineers, and building industry professionals to design everything from homes and businesses to airports, skyscrapers, and major landmarks.

In this role, you will help ensure that the software and cloud services our customers depend on are reliable, usable, and high quality. You will work as part of a collaborative, cross-functional Agile team alongside software developers, quality engineers, product managers, and other engineering partners.

This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career engineer who is interested in both software quality assurance and test automation
. You will develop skills across exploratory and functional testing, automated testing, cloud technologies, troubleshooting, and software development practices while contributing directly to the quality of Autodesk Revit and Revit Cloud Worksharing.

You will report to a Software Engineering Manager and work with teammates distributed across multiple regions and time zones. The team collaborates globally, so your working hours should provide meaningful overlap with the US Eastern time zone.

Responsibilities

Participate in Agile/Scrum team activities and contribute to discussions about product quality, test strategy, and release readiness
Work with developers, QA engineers, and Software Engineers in Test to understand new features and identify appropriate testing approaches
Create clear, well-structured test plans and test cases based on product requirements and real-world customer workflows
Perform functional, exploratory, integration, regression, and system testing across desktop and cloud-based components
Identify, reproduce, document, and help troubleshoot software defects
Learn to use logs, debugging tools, telemetry, and other diagnostic information to help isolate problems and identify potential root causes
Develop and maintain automated tests with guidance from more experienced engineers
Contribute automated tests to Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment pipelines
Review automated and manually collected test results and help identify failures, trends, and areas of risk
Help evaluate where automation can improve test coverage, reliability, and engineering efficiency
Simulate real-world customer workflows and provide feedback to developers and product designers about usability and product quality
Collaborate with Product Support and engineering teams to understand customer-reported issues and improve the post-release customer experience
Learn Revit, Revit Cloud Worksharing, and related Autodesk workflows and technologies
Participate in team and cross-team quality initiatives and share knowledge with teammates
Continuously develop your skills in software testing, automation, cloud technologies, and quality engineering practices

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Engineering, Architecture, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
Up to 2 years of professional, internship, co-op, academic, or project experience related to software development, software testing, engineering, or a similar technical discipline
Basic understanding of software testing concepts such as test cases, test plans, defect reporting, and debugging
Experience with or coursework in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, C#, JavaScript, Java, or similar
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with an interest in investigating how software works and why it fails
Ability and willingness to learn new applications, technologies, and development processes
Strong written and verbal communication skills
Ability to collaborate effectively within a diverse, globally distributed team
Curiosity, attention to detail, and a commitment to delivering a high-quality customer experience

Preferred Qualifications

Internship, academic, or professional experience with software quality assurance or automated testing
Familiarity with one or more automated testing tools or frameworks
Exposure to Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment concepts or tools
Familiarity with cloud platforms or cloud-based applications such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud
Experience working in Windows and/or Linux environments
Familiarity with Agile or Scrum software development practices
Knowledge of the Architecture, Engineering, and Construction (AEC) industry
Experience with Autodesk Revit or other Autodesk/AEC software
Experience designing buildings, working with BIM models, or using engineering or architecture software
Interest in learning both customer-focused quality assurance and software engineering approaches to automated testing
Basic experience using AI-assisted development tools to help write, understand, debug, or improve code and automated tests
Familiarity with using generative AI tools to assist with tasks such as creating test cases, generating test data, troubleshooting failures, or documenting technical work
An interest in learning how AI can be applied responsibly to improve software development, test automation, and quality engineering workflows

You do not need to meet every preferred qualification. We are looking for someone with a strong learning mindset who is excited to develop skills across software quality, test engineering, automation, and emerging AI-assisted development practices

What Will Help You Succeed

You will thrive in this role if:

You are curious and enjoy understanding how complex systems work
You approach problems from the customer’s point of view
You enjoy finding problems—and are equally interested in helping prevent them
You want to learn how automation can make software testing more reliable and efficient
You are comfortable asking questions, gathering feedback, and collaborating across disciplines
You use data and evidence to help make decisions
You see unexpected failures as opportunities to learn and improve
You take ownership of your work while seeking guidance when needed
You care about earning and maintaining our customers’ trust

Learn More

About Autodesk

Welcome to Autodesk! Amazing things are created every day with our software – from the greenest buildings and cleanest cars to the smartest factories and biggest hit movies. We help innovators turn their ideas into reality, transforming not only how things are made, but what can be made.

We take great pride in our culture here at Autodesk – it’s at the core of everything we do. Our culture guides the way we work and treat each other, informs how we connect with customers and partners, and defines how we show up in the world.

When you’re an Autodesker, you can do meaningful work that helps build a better world designed and made for all. Ready to shape the world and your future? Join us!

Salary transparency

Salary is one part of Autodesk’s competitive compensation package. For Romania based roles, we expect a starting base salary between 126,000 RON and 184,800 RON. Offers are based on the candidate’s experience and geographic location, and may exceed this range. In addition to base salaries, our compensation package may include annual cash bonuses, commissions for sales roles, stock grants, and a comprehensive benefits package.

Belonging

We take pride in cultivating a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive. Learn more here: https://www.autodesk.com/company/global-belonging

In-Person Onboarding and Identity Verification

This role may require in-person onboarding and/or in-person ID verification.

Je schoolt jezelf continu bij rond duurzame innovaties, met focus op cloud-native engineering, ontwikkeling en testing.

Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met regressie- en integratietesten, bij voorkeur met JUnit en Cucumber.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met performantie-, stress- en loadtesten, bij voorkeur met JMeter en Gatling.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met end-to-end testen.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met build tools, bij voorkeur Maven.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het opzetten van CI/CD-pipelines en het integreren van tests daarin, bij voorkeur met Azure DevOps.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met contract testing, mocking en service virtualisatie.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met het gebruik van SQL-databanken binnen testcontexten.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met samenwerken binnen agile delivery teams.
Je bent in staat alternatieve oplossingen voor te stellen en aanbevelingen te formuleren op basis van de volledige context.

Ervaring met ontwikkeling en integratie van microservices is een meerwaarde.
Ervaring met softwaredesign in cloud-, API-, microservice- of eventgedreven context is een meerwaarde.
Ervaring met event-driven architecture en systems is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van Event Driven Development en/of Behavioral Driven Development is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van Domain Driven Design is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van bestaande building blocks en services binnen een federale overheidscontext is een plus.
Je hebt een zeer goede kennis van het Engels en daarnaast een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans.

II. Takenpakket

II.a. Generiek
