jobs.title: Fullstack Software Engineer (x/f/m) - Global Architecture
jobs.description:
Health can’t wait
.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance.
Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a
unique culture
. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

🤘 How we do it ?

About

People joining Alan are always surprised and delighted by our innovative working method. We have a set of cultural values that guide our approach to work, such as:

🎯 What drives us - We're obsessed with helping members live healthier

Mission is the Boss
: long-term thinking, mission above all else
Member & customer-led
: obsessed with solving problems and delighting users

🏆 How we build excellence - We hire the best and empower them to succeed

Champions of excellence
: extremely high standards and talent density
Distributed ownership
: everyone owns their decisions and results
Radically transparent
: all information accessible, written-first, async decisions

🤝 How we grow together - We improve through honest feedback and bold thinking

Optimistic alchemy
: optimists who collaborate with genuine care
Empathetic challengers
: direct, caring feedback to help each other grow
Bold contrarians
: think differently, try new approaches

⚡ How we move fast — We fight complexity and focus on what matters

Disciplined execution
: decisive action with compounding focus
Fight for simplicity
: high-impact processes, smart frugality

⭐ The Engineering team ⭐

In our engineering team, we build the infrastructure, interfaces, and applications to provide first-class service to our members, health professionals, and even ourselves!

Being an engineer at Alan means joining a team of talented, committed and passionate engineers, with a lot of product interaction.

We move fast, with a lot of ownership, and are proud to tackle big problems!

Our process is very simple: those who make product decisions are the same ones who build them.

Our stack is Python/Flask, React, React Native, PostgreSQL.

Want to know more? Read this article if you want to discover how life as an Engineer at Alan and this article on our Engineering career path.

🌐 Enabling Global-First product development

In Alan's early expansion, we made a strategic decision to create separate codebases for each country we ventured into. This approach allowed us to quickly adapt and tailor our applications to meet the unique healthcare and regulatory requirements of France, Belgium, Spain, and Canada.

In 2024, we reached a crucial point where it was essential to merge these codebases into global, configurable modules
. Yet, writing local code is still easier than building global solutions. The Global Architecture team is central to this transformation — our goal is to enable any team at Alan to develop and launch features seamlessly across markets, as outlined in our 2025 technical strategy.

🚀 Your mission

Design Cross-Cutting Modules
You'll transform country-specific implementations into elegant global components that will become the new building blocks of other teams to build global features
Remove Technical Blockers for Product Teams
You’ll tackle technical blockers that cut across several domains and eliminate the need for team-specific workarounds, allowing product teams to focus on their core business
Orchestrate Data Transformations
You'll implement strategies to harmonize different countries' data models without losing local flexibility and consolidate existing data into unified schemas
Build and Own What You Create
You'll be responsible for the entire lifecycle of your solutions, from initial design through long-term maintenance. We don't just design — we build, deploy, and maintain what we create

🌟 Why This Role Matters

Focus on High-Impact, Cross-Domain Solutions
You work exclusively on blockers that span multiple business domains that are heavily depended upon. This means every solution you build has an impact across multiple teams
Enable Teams, Don't Replace Them
Your job isn't to substitute other teams or globalize everything. Instead, you'll work on technical obstacles that prevent teams from building global-first solutions and work with them to remove those obstacles
Learn and Share Globalization Patterns
As you design and implement global solutions, you'll develop an expertise in globalization patterns. You'll share these learnings with other teams, helping them make better decisions about global vs. local solutions in their own work

🚀 What we're looking for

You write code and maintain what you build. At Alan there is no architect in an ivory tower, we implement what we design
You’re able to navigate complex systems spanning multiple business domains and technical boundaries
You've worked with diverse architectural patterns and can articulate the nuanced trade-offs between them
You can spot technical obstacles that are blocking multiple teams and design solutions that remove those obstacles

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

We are looking for problem-solver engineers with 5+ years of experience who get excited about simplifying complex business problems:

You’ll be able to tackle high-impact & high-risk projects involving many engineers.
You’ll design efficient systems and engineering practices to align with and facilitate interactions between multiple teams/products.
You’ll have the opportunity to mentor other engineers & lead crews (more details in this article).
You’ll be able to contribute to hiring your future coworkers and shape candidates’ hiring experience (improving our technical assessment process etc...)

You would be a good fit at Alan if most of this sounds like you:

Well-versed in Object Oriented Programming such as Python, Java, C#, and enthusiastic about web technologies such as modern Javascript.
Willing to work in Python/JavaScript (but you don’t need to have experience with those 2 languages!).
Passionate about building products.
Self-starting and entrepreneurial.
Humble and still willing to grow (no matter your seniority!).
Collaborative, enthusiastic about teamwork, learning, and teaching.
Fluent in English (no need to speak French!).

For this opportunity, we are aiming to hire within the D-F level range.

But above all, we are looking for high potential and curiosity: make sure to show us this when you apply! Everything else is a bonus.

🙌 Perks & Benefits

At Alan, we believe that being in good health is a basic need,
and it starts with our employees. This is why Alaners are provided with a stimulating environment and perks ensuring they are happy, efficient and spend only high-quality time
with co-workers.

Therefore, we offer:

Fair rewards
. Generous equity packages complement your base salary.
Flexible Office
. Amazing office space at our HQ, sponsored co-working hubs or a full-remote experience with home office equipment sponsorship, we want you to live where you’re the happiest.
All the tools you need
. Top of the range equipment: Macbook Pro, keyboard, laptop stand, monitor, and noise-canceling headphones.
Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours
. Organize your time as you wish.
Delightful healthcare insurance:
Extremely comprehensive health insurance - 100% for you and your children, 90-100% for partners depending on your country (permanent contracts only).
Transport
. Country-specific commuter benefits.
Learning & Training opportunities.
A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.
Personal growth through coaching
: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk -
it's core to who we are. Every Alaner is paired with a dedicated coach from day one, who helps maximize their impact, nurture engagement, and navigate Alan's values to develop their full potential.
Learn more about our coaching culture
.

Parental leave.
Extended parental leave for all new parents.

Important note: we hire people, not roles.

If you're excited about this opportunity but don't check every box, we'd love to hear from you.
Everyone, no matter how underrepresented, should feel free to apply as it can only bring learnings or success.

If you identify yourself as a woman
: Did you know that research shows women often apply only when meeting 100% of requirements?

Remember, this is just a guide, not a checklist.

We'll be thrilled to receive your application!

🔖 Check out our About Alan and Career pages, as well as our Medium, blog and Glassdoor page for more info.

🔄 A quick note about the process

Note: While you're applying for a specific area,, you may join a different engineering team based on where we think you'll have the most impact. Check out descriptions of other areas here .

The result is highly localized managed protection that empowers security teams to be faster, smarter, and more cost efficient than ever before.

Continuous protection. AI-powered Nonstop SecOps. That’s Ontinue.

Role Overview

We’re looking for a QA Automation Engineer to help us scale quality across a fast-moving engineering team. This role is about building the automation, processes, and release confidence that keep pace with a team already working with AI-assisted development. You’ll support a medium-sized team on your own, so independence, organization, and the ability to create scalable ways of working are essential.

Design and implement automated tests for frontend, backend, and API flows
Use Playwright as a core testing platform, with tests written in TypeScript or C# depending on the best fit
Test microservices-based systems with an understanding of dependencies, release sequencing, and service interactions
Coordinate release readiness across the team, helping identify what needs to be tested first and what can go out together
Test Azure-based and event-driven workflows, including message-based scenarios such as Service Bus topics and related integrations
Combine automation with manual and exploratory testing where it adds the most value
Improve the way manual testing is enabled so it remains efficient and sustainable as the team grows
Collaborate closely with developers, the engineering manager, and other stakeholders to build a practical quality process
Use AI-assisted tools to speed up test creation, maintenance, triage, and analysis
Help ensure quality scales with the speed of the team instead of becoming a bottleneck

Required

Required Experience & Skills

At least 4 years of professional experience in QA, test automation, software engineering, or a closely related field
Strong experience with test automation, ideally across both frontend and API testing
Experience with Playwright or a similar modern automation framework
Good working knowledge of TypeScript, C#, or another language used for automation
Practical understanding of release coordination in microservices-based systems
Experience testing APIs and backend workflows
Familiarity with Azure or other cloud-based environments
A practical, organized approach to working independently and structuring your own process
Curious, adaptable, and open to using AI tools to work more efficiently
Strong communication skills and the ability to work closely with developers and stakeholders
A mindset that balances quality, speed, and pragmatism

Preferred

Experience building or improving QA processes for a growing team
Experience with event-driven or message-based systems
Experience with infrastructure or environment concepts that help with reliable testing
Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines and how automated tests fit into them
Experience using AI tools to support testing, analysis, or maintenance
Experience working in a product-oriented, fast-moving engineering environment
Experience with security-related or data-sensitive systems

What We Offer

We have been recognized as a top place to work! In addition to a competitive salary, we also offer great benefits and access to management and Microsoft training.

Come as you are! We search for amazing people of diverse backgrounds, experiences, abilities, and perspectives. Ontinue welcomes and encourages diversity in the workplace regardless of race, gender, religion, age, sexual orientation, disability, or veteran status.

Next Steps

If you have the skills and experience required and feel that Ontinue is a place you can belong, we would love to get to know you better! Please drop an application to this role and our talent acquisition manager will be in touch to discuss further.

to join our Playgami team in Barcelona

!

Playgami is Scopely's internal technology platform that powers some of the world's most successful live games. Our products help game teams operate and scale their games, serve millions of daily players, and process the vast amount of data generated across the Scopely ecosystem.

As an Engineering Manager, you will lead a team of engineers building the platforms, services, and tools that enable game teams to deliver exceptional player experiences. You will play a key role in shaping both the technical direction of our products and the growth of the engineers on your team.

What You’ll Do

Guide the design, architecture, and implementation of features and services that power world-class games at scale

Share knowledge, provide feedback, and help colleagues both inside and outside of your team

Strong leadership skills with a track record of building high-performing engineering teams
Excellent written and verbal English communication skills
Extensive experience in software development and system design
Strong proficiency in Java, C#, or another object-oriented language, including experience with asynchronous and concurrent programming paradigms
Hands-on experience with cloud computing (AWS, GCP...) and low-latency, high-scale distributed systems
A passion for solving complex problems and translating business needs into robust solutions
An appreciation for both business context and technical excellence in solution development
Willingness and interest in working across different technologies

Experience operating large-scale distributed systems serving millions of users
Knowledge of observability, monitoring, and incident management practices
Familiarity with the gaming industry, live operations, or game development ecosystems

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations:
Lisbon, Portugal

About the Role:

Do you love solving complex problems and interacting with people? Are you passionate about helping customers and are a standout colleague? Cloudflare is seeking a Technical Customer Support Engineer to join our team. You will work with our customers on a variety of technical support issues as well as the Technical Operations team that is responsible for running our global distributed network. This is a position where you will learn the inner workings of Cloudflare's technology and gain a deeper understanding of internet technologies. You will focus on providing support on our Developer Platform products: Workers, Workers AI, Pages, KV, Stream, R2, D1, DO etc.

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

You are familiar with Developer Platform products
You have previous experience working as part of a team in a customer-facing role
You have experience solving HTTP, DNS and other networking-related problems
You have experience with a common web development language (for example, Javascript)
You understand how the Internet works
You have experience working in a support role where you thrived every time you resolved a ticket
You are comfortable communicating through various support channels and always put the customer first (Emails, Live Chats, Phone calls and virtual meetings)
You are a motivated self-starter and always looking to expand your existing skill set

Bonus Points

You are fluent in German, Japanese, French, Spanish, Portuguese or Mandarin
You are familiar with Cloudflare and have a site actively using our platform

You have experience with Video encoding and streaming solutions

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary of €37,000-51,000.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo
: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project
: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1

This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

jobs.description:
Requisition ID 36613

Office Country Bulgaria

Office City Sofia

Division Information Technology

Contract Type Fixed Term

Contract Length 3 years

Posting End Date 26/10/2026

About The Platform

The European Bank for Reconstruction and Development (EBRD) is building a next-generation Client-Led Procurement (CLP) platform hosted on Microsoft Azure. The platform digitises procurement workflows across bankers (internal), clients, and external participants through four dedicated Angular portals backed by a microservices backend on Azure Kubernetes Service (AKS). The architecture follows a strict Service-Oriented Architecture (SOA) pattern: an API Management ingress layer, persona-specific BFF composer services, and independently deployable domain services.

What You’ll Do

As an Associate Full Stack Developer you will contribute to both the frontend Angular portals and the backend Spring Boot microservices that power the CLP platform. You will work within a cross-functional Agile team, taking features from specification through design, implementation, testing, and deployment on AKS. The role spans the full stack across all services on the platform.

Key Responsabilities

Design, implement, and maintain backend domain microservices using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
Build and enhance Angular single-page applications for the Internal, Client, Participant, and Public portals.
Implement and document RESTful APIs following OpenAPI/Swagger standards; contribute to API-first design reviews.
Work with the Azure data tier: Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Azure Blob Storage, and Cosmos DB.
Write and maintain Liquibase database migrations; ensure schema safety across environments.
Author unit, integration, and contract tests (JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test, Pact) and maintain coverage gates.
Containerise services with Docker and support deployment on AKS via Helm charts and CI/CD pipelines.
Participate in code reviews, architecture discussions, and threat-modelling sessions.
Contribute to observability: structured logging (Logback/Logstash), distributed tracing (Application Insights), and SLO dashboards.
Operate within EBRD engineering standards including SonarQube quality gates, SAST/DAST scanning, and branch policies.

Need To Have — Your Essentials

Backend — Java / Spring Boot

Java 21+: proficient in modern Java features — records, sealed classes, pattern matching, virtual threads
Spring Boot 3.x+: REST controllers, JPA/Hibernate, validation, actuator, autoconfiguration
RESTful API design: OpenAPI 3 / Swagger; resource modelling, versioning, error contracts
Azure Database for PostgreSQL: JDBC, JPA mappings, PostgreSQL SQL dialect, index-aware query design
Multi-module Gradle builds: buildSrc convention plugins, version catalogues (libs.versions.toml)
Testing: JUnit 5, Spring Boot Test (@SpringBootTest, @DataJpaTest), Mockito; targeting 80 %+ coverage
Git: branching strategies, pull-request-based workflow, code review

Frontend — Angular / TypeScript

Angular 21: components, services, reactive forms, RxJS, signals, Angular Router, lazy loading
TypeScript: strict mode, interfaces, generics, decorators
REST API consumption: HttpClient, error handling, interceptors, environment configuration
HTML5 / CSS3: responsive layouts, WCAG accessibility awareness
State management: NgRx or equivalent reactive state pattern

Cloud & Platform

Microsoft Azure: working knowledge of AKS, Azure Storage, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, Key Vault, and Managed Identity concepts
Docker: Dockerfile authoring, multi-stage builds, container image best practices
CI/CD: experience with any major pipeline tool (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, Jenkins); automated build → test → deploy flow
Observability basics: structured logging, correlation IDs, health endpoints (Spring Actuator)

Architecture & Ways of Working

Microservices / SOA: service decomposition, bounded contexts, API contracts between services
Security awareness: OAuth 2.0 / OIDC fundamentals, token validation, least-privilege data access
Agile / Scrum: sprint ceremonies, backlog refinement, Definition of Done
Code quality: SOLID principles, clean code, peer review, static analysis

Nice to Have

The following skills are advantageous but not required at hire; you will develop many of them on the job.

Azure Platform (Advanced)

Azure Blob Storage — SAS token issuance, lifecycle policies, blob versioning
Azure Service Bus — AMQP messaging, topics/subscriptions, dead-letter queues, idempotent consumers
Azure API Management (APIM) — inbound/outbound policy authoring, JWT validation, rate limiting, CORS
Azure Entra ID / B2C — OIDC flows, custom policies, app roles, SCIM provisioning
Azure Application Insights / Monitor — distributed tracing, workbooks, alert rules
Azure Front Door / Application Gateway / WAF

Kubernetes & Infrastructure

AKS — pod lifecycle, HPA, PodDisruptionBudgets, namespace isolation
Helm — chart authoring, values overrides, release management
Workload Identity / Managed Identity on AKS — federated credential binding, RBAC scoping
Terraform — IaC for Azure resources, state management, module patterns

Data & Integration

Cosmos DB — SQL API or MongoDB API, partition key design, RU/s governance
Liquibase — changeset authoring, rollback strategies, multi-environment safety
GraphQL — schema design, query/mutation authoring, Apollo or Spring GraphQL
Azure Application Insights — distributed tracing, dependency tracking, performance monitoring, and alerting

Workflow & Quality Engineering

Camunda 7 or 8 — BPMN modelling, external task workers, compensation patterns
Contract testing — Pact (consumer-driven), provider verification in CI
SonarQube / Jacoco — quality gate configuration, branch/PR analysis
SAST / DAST / dependency scanning — integration in CI pipelines

Why You’ll Love This Role

Exposure to a modern, greenfield Azure-native platform built from first principles.
Work across the full stack — Angular portals, Spring Boot domain services, AKS, and Azure data services.
Collaborative, high-trust engineering culture with strong code-review and architecture practices.

What is it like to work at the EBRD? / About EBRD

Our agile and innovative approach is what makes life at the EBRD a unique experience! You will be part of a pioneering and diverse international organisation, and use your talents to make a real difference to people's lives and help shape the future of the regions we invest in.

At EBRD, our Values – Inclusiveness, Innovation, Trust, and Responsibility – are at the heart of how we work. We bring these to life through our Workplace Behaviours: listening well and speaking up, collaborating smartly, acting decisively with full commitment, and simplifying to amplify our impact. These principles shape our culture and define our success. We seek individuals who not only share these values but are also committed to embedding them in their daily work, fostering a positive and high-performing environment.

A working culture that embraces inclusion and celebrates diversity. Our workforce reflects a broad range of backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, bringing fresh ideas, energy, and innovation and enhancing our ability to serve our clients, shareholders, and counterparties effectively.

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Remote)
new_jobs.description:
Reports to an Engineering Manager

Remote (working hours within ±2 hours of CET)

You'll own a slice of our platform outright, not just the tickets in it. Can you make the sound call, ship it, and leave the code healthier than you found it? Read on.

Why this role exists

We're growing Engineering's capacity. As the platform and team scale, we need engineers who can take a component and run with it independently — spotting risks early and raising the people around them.

About C Teleport

We move maritime, aviation, and energy crews around the world, automating high-stakes travel that used to be run by hand. We're a lean, international company: small squads, real ownership, decisions made close to the work.

What You'll Own

A component or a slice of the system, independently. Make the technical calls, keep it healthy, and know it well enough to catch problems before they become incidents.
Production. Ship what you build and keep it running for real users, not just "done" in a ticket.
Requirements, not just tickets. Turn a business need into a clear technical plan with Product, and flag gaps early.
Raising the bar around you. Teach what you know, exchange feedback across the team, and document so your team isn't stuck without you.
Your own delivery, reliably. Deliver what you commit to, and flag a slip early.
Making the team's practices better. Improve a process, tool, or approach that no longer fits.

Must-haves (these are gates)

You've independently owned a component or service in production — you made the calls, kept it healthy, and were accountable when something broke.
You can turn a business requirement into a technical plan yourself, working directly with Product or another stakeholder.
You mentor as you go; you can point to specific examples of raising another engineer's skill or judgment.
You deliver what you commit to, and say so early when you won't.
You're comfortable working within ±2 hours of CET, for real-time overlap with the team.
4+ years of hands-on .NET and C#, as your active day-to-day language.
You actively use AI coding agents for implementation and code review. You can guide them effectively, critically assess their output, and take ownership of the resulting code.
You apply OOD, TDD, SOLID, and CQRS deliberately; the right pattern, not just the first one.
Strong analytical skills, proactive, and quick to pick up new concepts.

Nice-to-haves (bonus, Genuinely Not Required)

Experience working fully remote in a distributed team.
A track record of landing a tool, pattern, or process change that became your team's standard.
Experience owning a production incident end to end, including the postmortem and fix.
Proficiency with NoSQL databases.
Experience with message brokers (RabbitMQ or similar).
Experience with Galileo, Amadeus, or other travel-industry APIs — a strong plus given our domain.

This is not…

…an entry-level seat. You'll own a component early on, not a queue of pre-specified tickets.
…a people-management role. No direct reports — your influence comes from your ownership and how much you raise the people around you.
…the technical ceiling. The next step is Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's technical direction. This is the runway to it.

Remote and working hours

Fully remote, with working hours within ±2 hours of CET/CEST for real-time overlap with the team.

What You Get

A remote-first setup, built for distributed work.
A clear next step: Staff Software Engineer, owning a whole domain's direction.

Hiring process

Recruiter / HR call — role, motivation, and logistics.
Technical interview — a deep dive on how you've owned production systems, plus a technical exercise.
Final call with the Engineering Manager you'd report to.

Target: ~2–3 weeks end to end.

Pre-employment screening

If your application is successful, we may conduct a pre-employment screening through a trusted third party, in line with applicable laws. This may include employment history, education, and other relevant publicly available information to help us understand your suitability for the role.

Equal opportunity and privacy

C Teleport is an equal-opportunity employer. We assess every application on merit and handle your data in line with GDPR.

new_jobs.title: .NET (C#) Software Architect - Rail & Public Transport
new_jobs.description:
Wij zoeken een ervaren .NET (C#) Software Architect met een sterke technische achtergrond in het ontwerpen en realiseren van complexe, bedrijf kritische systemen. De architect heeft ruime ervaring met het ontwerpen van schaalbare en betrouwbare softwareoplossingen en combineert diepgaande technische kennis met sterke analytische en communicatieve vaardigheden.

De ideale kandidaat heeft ervaring met architectuur, systeemontwerp en ontwikkeling van real-time en gedistribueerde systemen en werkt comfortabel in omgevingen waar meerdere databronnen, externe services en gespecialiseerde systemen veilig en betrouwbaar met elkaar moeten samenwerken. Daarnaast heeft de kandidaat ervaring met het begeleiden van ontwikkelteams en het vertalen van business- en systeemrequirements naar robuuste technische oplossingen.

De architect speelt een sleutelrol in het definiëren van architectuurprincipes, het begeleiden van development teams en het waarborgen van kwaliteit, performance en onderhoudbaarheid van softwareoplossingen. Werkt bij voorkeur in een Agile/Scrum omgeving en draagt actief bij aan continue verbetering van ontwikkelprocessen.

Belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden

Ontwerpen en definiëren van softwarearchitecturen voor complexe systemen
Vertalen van functionele en niet-functionele requirements naar technische oplossingen
Ontwikkelen en begeleiden van implementaties in C# / .NET
Ontwerpen van integraties met externe systemen, services en databronnen
Bewaken van softwarekwaliteit, security, performance en schaalbaarheid
Technische coaching en begeleiding van ontwikkelteams
Samenwerken met stakeholders zoals product owners, architecten, operations en business

Gewenste technische ervaring

Sterke ervaring met C# / .NET development
Architectuur van distributed, high-availability of real-time systems
Integratie via webservices, messaging of API’s (REST, SOAP, XML)
Ervaring met Linux en/of Windows omgevingen
Kennis van CI/CD, automated testing en moderne ontwikkelpraktijken
Ervaring met databases en data-integratie

Methodologie & werkwijze

Agile / Scrum
Requirements analyse en system engineering
Testautomatisering en kwaliteitsborging
Technische leadership en team coaching

Gewenste achtergrond

Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in complexe technische omgevingen zoals infrastructuur, rail, luchtvaart, industrie of kritische systemen
Sterk analytisch vermogen en probleemoplossend denken
Goede communicatieve vaardigheden in Nederlands en Engels (geen pré)
Een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding.

Een pre-employment screening maakt onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure

Waar kom je terecht?

CGI Rail, gevestigd in Rotterdam, werkt aan de transformatie van railsystemen die essentieel zijn voor de besturing van het Nederlandse spoorwegnet. Je komt te werken in onze hechte RailInfra Unit binnen de sector Rail & Public Transport. Hier werk je aan het vernieuwen van bestaande IT-systemen en het ontwikkelen van nieuwe platformen die cruciaal zijn voor de veiligheid, betrouwbaarheid en beschikbaarheid van het spoor.

Onze systemen ondersteunen onder andere de aansturing van seinen en wissels, leveren realtime informatie aan treindienstleiders en vormen de basis voor simulatie- en opleidingssystemen. Binnen CGI Public Transport werken ongeveer 250 professionals aan innovatieve oplossingen om mobiliteit te verbeteren, capaciteit te vergroten en het spoor toekomstbestendig te maken.

Waarom CGI

CGI is één van 's werelds grootste IT-consultancy bedrijven. Onze mensen houden Nederland draaiende. Overheidsinstellingen, banken, lucht- en ruimtevaart, infrastructurele organisaties en energie- en productiebedrijven zijn klanten van CGI. We werken aan interessante projecten die het alledaagse leven van miljoenen mensen raken. We zijn regionaal aanwezig, versterkt met wereldwijde domeinkennis, ons ecosysteem en collega's verspreid over de hele wereld. We zijn trots op de impactvolle projecten die we samen met onze collega’s tot een succes maken.

Bij CGI hechten we veel waarde aan diversiteit en inclusie, omdat dit niet alleen de samenwerking bevordert, maar ook vaak leidt tot betere resultaten. Ook kijken we continu naar de impact van nieuwe technologieën op onze dienstverlening en de oplossingen die we voor onze klanten ontwikkelen. Ook ontwikkelingen op het gebied van AI en automatisering spelen hierin een steeds grotere rol. We kijken uit naar jouw bijdrage aan ons team!

We bieden je een vast contract, zodat je meteen baanzekerheid hebt. Parttime werken, bijvoorbeeld 32 of 36 uur per week is bespreekbaar, wij bieden jou graag die flexibiliteit. Daarnaast vinden wij het belangrijk dat iedereen bij ons zich eigenaar van hun eigen werk voelt. Letterlijk eigenaar, want bij CGI krijg je de mogelijkheid om aandeelhouder te worden en zo mee te delen in onze successen.

Verder vinden wij het belangrijk dat jij geïnspireerd blijft, de dingen doet waar jij warm voor loopt en je kunt blijven ontwikkelen. Via onze CGI Academy kun je allerlei relevante trainingen volgen. Wat we nog meer te bieden hebben: een plek in een hecht team van professionals waar we samen met elkaar de verantwoordelijkheid voor de ontwikkeling van onze klanten en medewerkers dragen. Een team waarmee we klantverwachtingen kunnen overtreffen en ons binnen en buiten CGI op de kaart kunnen zetten. Een rol in ons CGI-verhaal!

Samenvattend bieden wij jou:

De kans om te werken in kleine zelfsturende teams bestaande uit experts in je vakgebied
De regie over je eigen carrière met daarbij de ruimte om jezelf te blijven ontwikkelen
Je werkt met de nieuwste technologieën
Een uitstekend salaris en aantrekkelijke secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden
Direct een vast contract
Parttime mogelijkheden
En de mogelijkheid om CGI-aandeelhouder te worden

Sluit je aan bij ons team van experts en solliciteer direct!

Meer informatie over de inhoud van de vacature? Neem contact op met Director Consulting Servcies Yashvir Sewcharan via 06 571 042 35 of via yas.sewcharan@cgi.com.

Vragen over de sollicitatieprocedure? Neem contact op met Recruitment Business Partner Natrah Pula via 06 112 187 23 of via Natrah.pula@cgi.com.

Wij werken niet samen met externe recruitment-partijen.

Acquisitie naar aanleiding van onze vacatures wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld!

Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Criteria

Together, as owners, let’s turn meaningful insights into action.

In 1976 opgericht als een familiebedrijf, is CGI vandaag de dag een van de grootste onafhankelijke zakelijke en ICT-dienstverleners ter wereld. Bij ons draait het om ownership, teamwork en respect. Je krijgt de ruimte om al je talenten volledig te ontplooien.

Vanaf je eerste werkdag ben je mede-eigenaar van CGI. We profiteren samen van ons succes en je krijgt de kans én verantwoordelijkheid om actief bij te dragen aan de koers en strategie van ons bedrijf.

Jouw inzet voegt waarde toe. Je werkt aan innovatieve oplossingen en bouwt aan je netwerk van collega's en klanten. Je hebt toegang tot wereldwijde kansen om je ideeën te realiseren, mogelijkheden te benutten en te profiteren van onze kennis van de industrie en technologische expertise.

Ontdek bij ons de mogelijkheden voor jouw persoonlijke ontwikkeling en zet de volgende stap in je carrière. Hier staat jouw succes centraal!

Stanowisko To Podlega

Innovation Enablement Manager

__

As a Sales Configurator Product Modeler / Developer you will be a member of a team developing and maintaining sales configurators solutions supporting the operations and customers of ABB Electrification (EL) - Distribution Solution (ELDS) and Service (ELSE). You will be working in a cross-functional team which operates in an international environment.

In this role you will be responsible for the modelling and maintenance of distribution systems and service products (switchgears, grid components and service offering ) in the new global ELDS/SE sales configurator platform(s). You will closely collaborate with product sales configurators, portfolio managers and engineers to design, implement, test and troubleshoot the product models. Together with the internal ABB IS and Business Teams you will have unique opportunity to learn the product portfolio and based on that design and deliver the future platform ensuring it meets the needs of our customers and sales team

The work model for the role is: #hybrid;

You Will Be Mainly Accountable For

Design, implement, test, and troubleshoot product models for ELDS and ELSE.
Develop the product models as defined by the Product Managers / Sales Configurators Portfolio Managers and Engineers. Ensure product models are well-structured to enable high quality change management and simplify the future maintenance
Collaborate with relevant IS and Business stakeholders to deliver a user-friendly and efficient Sales Configurator solution.
Work closely with the platform supplier / implementation partner to ensure the integrity of the product model is guaranteed as the platform evolves.
Provide technical support, troubleshooting and fixing issues reported by users.
Contribute to the overall sales configurator development process

Qualifications For The Role

You are highly skilled in product modelling and configuration within sales configurator tools and enjoy working in the industrial technology and engineering sector
You have established experience in the software development lifecycle, including working with tools such as Azure DevOps
You possess solid expertise in programming languages such as .NET, Python, Java, or similar technologies
You are highly adept in configurator platforms, with experience in Configit ACE considered an advantage
You are passionate about teamwork and collaboration, while also demonstrating a proactive, solution-oriented, and independent working style
You are resilient in agile, fast-paced environments and are motivated by continuous learning and development
You have proven experience or a strong understanding of industrial product portfolios; knowledge of ABB’s DS and SE Division portfolio is considered a plus

We are seeking an Principal Solution Architect to lead the evolution of Autodesk Consulting’s Intellectual Property platform as an enterprise-ready SaaS product powered by knowledge architecture, AI-enabled capabilities, and future agentic applications.

Working across product, engineering, architecture, and consulting teams, you will design the knowledge architecture that connects workflows, data, decisions, and insights across the AEC, MFG, and M&E domains. You will establish the semantic models, knowledge graph capabilities, and platform architecture required to support organizational change management, workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications.

This is an individual contributor role that reports to the Sr. Manager, Architecture.

Responsibilities

Define and evolve the architectural vision for Workflow Advisory and related knowledge-driven platform capabilities
Design semantic architectures, knowledge models, and knowledge graph capabilities that connect workflows, data, decisions, and insights
Define architecture patterns that enable workflow automation, intelligent decision support, and future agentic applications
Establish standards for knowledge representation, lifecycle management, governance, and reuse across platforms
Translate business workflows into reusable domain models, services, and architectural patterns
Design scalable, secure, and resilient cloud-native architectures that support enterprise and customer-facing solutions
Ensure platform services, APIs, and knowledge assets are discoverable, composable, and consumable by AI-enabled applications
Apply AI and LLM technologies to improve knowledge discovery, workflow execution, and advisory experiences
Collaborate with architects and engineering responsible for ensuring architecture meets enterprise security, privacy, compliance, and SOC2 requirements
Collaborate with product, engineering, and consulting teams to align architecture investments with business outcomes and technology strategy
Drive adoption of architectural standards and reusable platform capabilities across teams
Mentor engineers and architects while communicating architectural direction to senior leadership and stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
10+ years of experience designing and delivering complex software platforms
Experience as a Software Architect, Product Architect, Principal Engineer, or equivalent technical leadership role
Experience designing AI-enabled, knowledge-driven, or workflow-centric software systems
Experience with knowledge graphs, semantic architectures, ontologies, taxonomies, graph databases, or retrieval systems
Experience evaluating and implementing AI technologies, including LLMs, RAG architectures, intelligent assistants, or autonomous agent patterns
Experience leading technical spikes, rapid prototyping efforts, or proof-of-concept development
Deep understanding of cloud-native architectures, APIs, distributed systems, and modern software engineering practices
Experience designing secure, privacy-conscious, and trustworthy software platforms that operate within enterprise governance requirements
Excellent written, verbal, and presentation skills with the ability to communicate complex ideas to both technical and non-technical audiences

new_jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Do you want to build and modernize a market-leading SaaS platform that transforms complex transportation data into business value?

At IMI, we develop a market-leading SaaS platform that helps organizations control transportation costs, automate financial processes, and transform complex operational data into valuable business insights. Processing large volumes of business-critical data, our platform supports customers in improving efficiency, control, and decision-making.

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our team. You will work across the entire software development lifecycle and play a key role in the continued evolution of a business-critical SaaS platform.

Combining hands-on development with technical ownership, you will influence architecture, development practices, and technical decisions while helping deliver scalable, high-quality solutions.

About The Role

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will become an important part of a cross-functional team responsible for developing, maintaining, and modernizing business-critical software solutions. You will work across frontend, backend, databases, integrations, and cloud services while taking responsibility for delivering stable, scalable, and high-quality solutions.

The role involves close collaboration with product stakeholders, developers, customers, and domain experts. Beyond implementation, you will contribute to technical design, support the modernization of existing services, and take ownership of solutions throughout their entire lifecycle, from initial requirements to stable production use.

Key Responsibilities:

Develop and enhance software solutions across frontend, backend, and databases
Translate product requirements into stable, scalable, and user-friendly solutions
Develop APIs and integrations with external systems
Contribute to the modernization of existing services and the reduction of technical debt
Work with data models, SQL, reporting, and analytical datasets
Ensure quality through testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, and production follow-up
Contribute to technical decisions, architecture, and development standards while taking ownership of deliveries from design through production

Your Profile

We believe you are an experienced software engineer with strong technical expertise and a product-oriented mindset. You enjoy solving complex challenges, modernizing existing solutions, and building scalable systems that create lasting business value.

You thrive in an environment that combines ownership, autonomy, and collaboration. Taking responsibility for technical decisions and architecture, you balance technical quality with business needs while contributing to continuous improvement and knowledge sharing.

We Believe You Have:

A degree in Software Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent hands-on experience
Solid and documented experience developing and maintaining production-critical software solutions
Experience developing transaction-intensive systems that process large volumes of business-critical data
Experience with C#, .NET, SQL, relational databases, and modern frontend development using JavaScript or TypeScript
Experience working with APIs, integrations, and cloud platforms such as Azure
Experience with automated testing, code reviews, troubleshooting, CI/CD, and modern software delivery practices
Experience taking responsibility for complete deliveries from requirements and technical design through deployment and production follow-up
Strong communication skills in both Norwegian and English

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience modernizing legacy or business-critical systems
Experience with Azure services, message-based or asynchronous architectures, and scalable cloud solutions
Experience with reporting, analytics, simulation, or data-intensive B2B products
Experience integrating with ERP systems or other external platforms
Experience with technical leadership, mentoring, or professional coaching
Experience with customer dialogue, requirements gathering, or logistics-related solutions

The position is primarily based in Fredrikstad. We work mainly from the office, with flexibility to work remotely when needed.

Why IMI?

IMI Supply Chain Solutions is a leading software provider specializing in sustainable logistics and order management. Our solutions are at the core of critical industries such as grocery retail and pharmaceutical supply chains. We are in an exciting phase of growth, offering you the opportunity to influence both our products and the way we work with product development going forward.

We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified and offer a workplace with a strong sense of team spirit, a high degree of autonomy, and excellent opportunities for professional development. In addition, we offer a competitive benefits package including extra vacation days and an attractive pension plan.

Application

Is this the right role for you? We warmly welcome your application. Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis. If you have any questions about the position, please contact our HR Business Partner, Ebba Olofsson, at ebba.olofsson@im.se.

Bankacılık ve kurumsal sistem entegrasyonlarında görev alabilecek, güçlü teknik altyapıya sahip deneyimli bir ekip arkadaşı arıyoruz.
Özellikle banka, finans kuruluşu veya büyük ölçekli kurumsal yapılarda geliştirme yapmış; kurum içi sistemlerin geliştirme, entegrasyon, güvenlik ve deployment süreçlerine hakim adaylarla tanışmak istiyoruz.

Modern web uygulamaları geliştirme konusunda güçlü deneyim
C# ve .NET Core / ASP.NET Core teknolojilerinde ileri seviye bilgi ve aktif geliştirme deneyimi

REST API ve servis tabanlı mimariler konusunda güçlü deneyim
Microservice veya modüler monolith mimarilerine hakimiyet

CI/CD süreçleri, Git tabanlı geliştirme ve deployment pipeline'ları konusunda deneyim
MS SQL Server ve ilişkisel veritabanlarında güçlü bilgi

API Gateway, ESB veya kurumsal entegrasyon katmanlarıyla çalışmış olmak
On-premise ve private cloud sistemlerle entegrasyon tecrübesi
Audit, KVKK ve bilgi güvenliği gereksinimlerine uygun sistem geliştirme deneyimi

Web ve backend geliştirme süreçlerinde aktif rol almak
Kurumsal sistem entegrasyonlarının teknik tasarımını ve geliştirmesini gerçekleştirmek
Banka IT, altyapı, güvenlik ve yazılım ekipleriyle teknik süreçleri yürütmek

new_jobs.title: Freelance Expert Test Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

Voor een grootschalig moderniseringstraject binnen een federale context zoeken we een hands-on Test Engineer met aantoonbare expertise in testautomatisering en kwaliteitsborging van complexe IT-oplossingen. Je werkt mee aan een ambitieus programma met een strakke timing, in een omgeving met cloud, API’s, microservices en zero-trust-principes.

In deze rol vertaal je een teststrategie naar een operationeel en agile testplan, zowel functioneel als technisch. Je implementeert dit plan zelf zo veel mogelijk geautomatiseerd, zodat de kwaliteit, robuustheid en veiligheid van de oplossing bewaakt blijven. Je werkt daarbij samen met ervaren collega’s in een multidisciplinair team.

Dit is nadrukkelijk geen pure lead- of adviesfunctie. De focus ligt op analyse, ontwerp én uitvoering. Er wordt verwacht dat je regelmatig op kantoor aanwezig bent, met een richtlijn van drie dagen per week.

Jouw profiel

Je beschikt over een diploma hoger onderwijs in informatica (korte of lange type).
Je hebt minstens 10 jaar ervaring als Test Engineer in een hands-on context.
Je hebt in de voorbije jaren zelf oplossingen geïmplementeerd, geïntegreerd en gebruikt, en niet alleen aangestuurd via andere teams.
Je schoolt jezelf continu bij rond duurzame innovaties, met focus op cloud-native engineering, ontwikkeling en testing.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar hands-on ervaring met monitoring en observability van softwareoplossingen, bij voorkeur met Grafana.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar hands-on ervaring met testautomatisering.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar programmeerervaring met Java SE10+.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar hands-on ervaring met scripting in Python en JavaScript.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met API-testframeworks en -tools, bij voorkeur Bruno.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met UI-testframeworks en -tools, bij voorkeur Cypress, inclusief goede kennis van de HTML DOM.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met regressie- en integratietesten, bij voorkeur met JUnit en Cucumber.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met performantie-, stress- en loadtesten, bij voorkeur met JMeter en Gatling.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met end-to-end testen.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met build tools, bij voorkeur Maven.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met het opzetten van CI/CD-pipelines en het integreren van tests daarin, bij voorkeur met Azure DevOps.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met contract testing, mocking en service virtualisatie.
Je hebt minimaal 3 jaar ervaring met het gebruik van SQL-databanken binnen testcontexten.
Je hebt minimaal 5 jaar ervaring met samenwerken binnen agile delivery teams.
Je bent in staat alternatieve oplossingen voor te stellen en aanbevelingen te formuleren op basis van de volledige context.
Je communiceert vlot met zowel technische als niet-technische stakeholders en combineert een flexibele houding met sterke luistervaardigheden.
Ervaring met design, definitie en ontwikkeling van API’s is een meerwaarde.
Ervaring met ontwikkeling en integratie van microservices is een meerwaarde.
Ervaring met softwaredesign in cloud-, API-, microservice- of eventgedreven context is een meerwaarde.
Ervaring met event-driven architecture en systems is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van Event Driven Development en/of Behavioral Driven Development is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van Domain Driven Design is een meerwaarde.
Kennis van bestaande building blocks en services binnen een federale overheidscontext is een plus.
Je hebt een zeer goede kennis van het Engels en daarnaast een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans.

II. Takenpakket

II.a. Generiek

Je beschikt over een brede en gevarieerde skillset om het kwaliteitsniveau van IT-oplossingen te bepalen, te ontwerpen, te implementeren en te beheren.
Je bent een energieke Test Engineer met passie voor IT, een positieve can-do mentaliteit en een sterke teamgerichte aanpak.
Je werkt als kernlid van een multidisciplinair en cross-functioneel team en draagt actief bij aan gezamenlijke probleemoplossing, geavanceerd ontwerp en kwalitatieve oplevering.
Je begrijpt de volledige solution stack en het IT-design, zodat je het team kunt begeleiden bij het ontwerpen en ontwikkelen van veilige en robuuste oplossingen.
Je zet je technische expertise in tijdens alle sprint events, zoals planning, refinement, retrospectives en demo’s.
Je blijft je expertise verder uitbouwen en deelt actief kennis over nieuwe tools, technieken en werkwijzen binnen het team.

II.b. Specifiek (niet exhaustief)

Je werkt een testaanpak uit voor de oplossing en stuurt die bij waar nodig, inclusief de operationele uitrol ervan.
Je voert functionele testen uit, met focus op validatie van businesslogica in microservices en API’s, dataintegriteit en end-to-end gebruikersflows.
Je staat in voor API-testen, waaronder validatie van API-contracten (OpenAPI) en testen op functionaliteit, performantie, beveiliging en compatibiliteit met externe systemen.
Je automatiseert API-testen maximaal zodat continue integratie optimaal ondersteund wordt.
Je voert integratietesten uit op de samenwerking tussen microservices, COTS-componenten, externe API’s en adapters, inclusief foutscenario’s.
Je neemt beveiligingstesten op rond authenticatie, autorisatie en encryptie.
Je test performantie en schaalbaarheid van microservices, API’s en de bredere oplossing.
Je ontwikkelt en onderhoudt geautomatiseerde testsuites in CI/CD-pipelines om snelle feedback in DevOps-processen mogelijk te maken.
Je helpt mee bij het opzetten van monitoring, logging en observability in omgevingen zoals development, test en acceptatie.

I. Talen

Door de aard van de functie en de tweetalige werkomgeving is een zeer goede kennis van het Engels vereist, aangevuld met een zeer goede kennis van het Nederlands of het Frans.

Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

Proactively adopt and promote new methodologies, including AI-driven development workflows and continuous integration.

Mindset: Highly proactive, self-driven, and methodical. An "out-of-the-box" thinker who drives excellence and continuous improvement.

Deep experience in Cyber Security, Secrets Management, Identity Security, or OS-level security architecture.
Active integration of AI-assisted coding tools into daily development workflows.
Hands-on experience with AWS cloud technology stack and modern CI/CD practices (Jenkins, Artifactory).
